title: A triplet with its number suppressed
description: One eighth-note triplet whose showNumber is noNumber — the convention for passages saturated with identical tuplets, where repeating the 3 on every beat is noise. The renderer honors the suppression (no number, and no bracket gap reserved for one). The enum also offers inner and both; both is not distinguished from inner yet, which is recorded rather than exercised here so the golden pins only settled behavior.
